quests.title: Explore a street you've never walked down
quests.description: Pick a street near you that you have somehow never set foot on and walk its whole length. Notice one thing that surprises you.

quests.title: Take a different route home
quests.description: Choose a route you have never taken before, even if it is slower. Let yourself get slightly lost on purpose.

quests.title: Follow the third left
quests.description: Leave your door and take the third left, then the third right, then the third left again. See where the pattern delivers you.

quests.title: Climb to the highest point nearby
quests.description: Find the highest hill, tower, car park roof or public viewpoint within reach and look out over your territory.

quests.title: Board a random bus
quests.description: Take a bus or tram line you have never used and ride it to a stop that sounds interesting. Explore for twenty minutes, then find your way back.

quests.title: Sunrise expedition
quests.description: Wake before dawn and be somewhere outside with a view when the sun comes up.

quests.title: Night walk
quests.description: Take a walk after dark through a safe, familiar area and notice how different it feels. Listen more than you look.

quests.title: Find a hidden path
quests.description: Look at a map for a footpath, alley or trail near you that you did not know existed, and walk it.

quests.title: Cross a bridge you've never crossed
quests.description: Seek out a bridge, footbridge or stepping stones you have never crossed and cross it, pausing in the middle.

quests.title: Walk to the edge of your map
quests.description: Walk in one direction until you reach a place you have never been on foot. Mark it as the new border of your known world.

quests.title: Visit a town you've only driven through
quests.description: Stop in a nearby village or town you have only ever passed through and spend an hour exploring its centre.

quests.title: Day hike
quests.description: Plan and complete a proper hike of at least ten kilometres on a trail you have never walked.

quests.title: Sleep under the stars
quests.description: Camp out for a night, in a tent, a hammock or even the back garden, and watch the sky until you fall asleep.

quests.title: Walk in the rain on purpose
quests.description: Put on a coat (or don't) and take a walk while it rains. Jump in at least one puddle.

quests.title: Explore without a phone
quests.description: Leave your phone at home and wander your neighbourhood for an hour, navigating only by memory and signposts.

quests.title: Seek out a waterfall, spring or source
quests.description: Find the nearest waterfall, spring, fountain or river source and go and see it in person.

quests.title: Enter a building you always walk past
quests.description: There is a shop, church, library or hall you always walk past without entering. Today, go in.

quests.title: Take the scenic train
quests.description: Take a train journey to somewhere a little far away, choosing a window seat and watching the country roll past.

quests.title: Snow trek
quests.description: When there is snow on the ground, go out and make the first footprints across an untouched stretch of it.

quests.title: Chase the golden hour
quests.description: Find a good spot and watch the landscape turn gold in the hour before sunset.

quests.title: Paddle a new stretch of water
quests.description: Rent a kayak, canoe, rowing boat or paddleboard and explore a lake, river or coastline from the water.

quests.title: Geocache hunt
quests.description: Look up a geocache near you and try to find it. Leave something small in exchange if you can.

quests.title: Walk a full circle of your town
quests.description: Try to walk a loop that traces the rough outer edge of your town or district in one go.

quests.title: Find the oldest tree you can
quests.description: Search for the oldest, biggest tree in your area. Touch its bark and guess what it has lived through.

quests.title: Sketch something you see every day
quests.description: Draw an ordinary object you use daily, slowly and carefully, as if you had never seen one before.

quests.title: Blind contour portrait
quests.description: Draw a person's face (or your own in a mirror) without looking at the paper. Enjoy the strange result.

quests.title: Paint the sky right now
quests.description: Look out of the window and paint or colour the sky exactly as it is at this moment.

quests.title: Photo walk: one colour
quests.description: Take a walk and photograph only things of a single colour you pick before leaving.

quests.title: Make a zine
quests.description: Fold a sheet of paper into a tiny eight-page booklet and fill it with drawings, words or collage about anything you like.

quests.title: Visit a gallery and choose one painting
quests.description: Go to a gallery or exhibition and spend ten full minutes in front of a single work of art.

quests.title: Draw your street from memory
quests.description: Without looking, draw a map or picture of your street. Then go outside and compare.

quests.title: Chalk art on the pavement
quests.description: Buy or borrow chalk and leave a cheerful drawing or message on the pavement for others to find.

quests.title: Photograph ten doors
quests.description: Hunt down ten interesting doors in your area and photograph each one. Which would you most like to open?

quests.title: Make a collage from old magazines
quests.description: Tear up old magazines, flyers or packaging and assemble them into a collage with a mood or story.

quests.title: Paint with your non-dominant hand
quests.description: Paint or draw a small scene using only the hand you don't write with.

quests.title: Sculpt something from clay or dough
quests.description: Shape a small creature or object out of clay, salt dough or even bread dough.

quests.title: Sketch in a café
quests.description: Sit in a café or public space and sketch the people and objects around you, quickly and without judgement.

quests.title: Take a macro photograph
quests.description: Get as close as your camera allows to something small (a leaf, an insect, a fabric) and find a hidden world.

quests.title: Create a nature mandala
quests.description: Gather fallen leaves, stones, petals and sticks and arrange them into a circular pattern outside. Leave it for others.

quests.title: Draw a map of an imaginary kingdom
quests.description: Invent a kingdom and draw its map: mountains, rivers, towns, dragons' lairs and all.

quests.title: Paint a rock and hide it
quests.description: Paint a small stone with a picture or kind message and hide it somewhere for a stranger to discover.

quests.title: Attend a life-drawing session
quests.description: Find a drop-in life-drawing or urban sketching session and join in, whatever your skill level.

quests.title: Shadow drawing
quests.description: Place objects in sunlight or lamplight and trace their shadows onto paper. Turn the shapes into something new.

quests.title: Photo series: the life of a single hour
quests.description: Take one photograph every five minutes for an hour, wherever you are. Look at the twelve pictures together.

quests.title: Build a tiny diorama
quests.description: Create a small scene inside a shoebox or jar: a forest, a tavern, a castle courtyard.

quests.title: Paint a postcard and post it
quests.description: Paint a small picture on a card and send it through the post to someone who won't expect it.

quests.title: Try calligraphy
quests.description: Practise an old-fashioned hand: blackletter, uncial or copperplate. Write a single motto beautifully.

quests.title: Write a six-word story
quests.description: Write a complete story in exactly six words. Then write five more.

quests.title: Invent a new recipe
quests.description: Combine ingredients you already have into a dish you have never made or seen before. Give it a grand name.

quests.title: Compose a tavern song
quests.description: Write a short verse and chorus about your day in the style of a rowdy tavern song. Sing it, at least quietly.

quests.title: Design a coat of arms
quests.description: Design your own heraldic coat of arms: colours, charges, a creature and a motto that sums you up.

quests.title: Build a blanket fort
quests.description: Construct the most ambitious blanket fort your home allows and spend some time inside it.

quests.title: Write a letter to your future self
quests.description: Write a letter to be opened one year from today. Seal it and hide it somewhere safe.

quests.title: Invent a board game
quests.description: Create a simple board game with paper, coins and a die. Play at least one round, even alone.

quests.title: Repurpose something broken
quests.description: Take an object that is broken or unused and turn it into something useful or beautiful.

quests.title: Write a poem about the weather
quests.description: Look outside and write a short poem about exactly the weather you see today.

quests.title: Create a playlist soundtrack for your life
quests.description: Make a playlist that would be the soundtrack to a film about your life so far. Give each song a scene.

quests.title: Write a fable
quests.description: Write a short fable with talking animals and a moral at the end.

quests.title: Make up a constellation
quests.description: Look at the night sky, connect some stars into a shape of your own and invent the myth behind it.

quests.title: Make a stop-motion clip
quests.description: Use your phone to make a ten-second stop-motion animation with household objects.

quests.title: Knot, weave or braid something
quests.description: Learn a decorative knot, weave a small mat or braid a bracelet from string or yarn.

quests.title: Write the menu of an imaginary tavern
quests.description: Invent a tavern and write its full menu, including prices, specials and ominous warnings.

quests.title: Design your dream home floorplan
quests.description: Draw the floorplan of your ideal home, including one completely impractical room.

quests.title: Make music with household objects
quests.description: Find five objects that make interesting sounds and compose a short rhythm or piece with them.

quests.title: Record a short podcast episode
quests.description: Record five minutes talking about something you love, as if to an eager audience.

quests.title: Write a letter from a medieval traveller
quests.description: Write a letter as if you were a traveller in the year 1350, describing your journey so far.

quests.title: Build a bird feeder
quests.description: Make a simple bird feeder from a bottle, carton or pine cone and hang it outside.

quests.title: Invent a word
quests.description: Invent a new word for a feeling or situation that does not yet have a name. Use it in conversation.

quests.title: Create a secret code
quests.description: Invent a cipher and write a message in it. Hide the message somewhere for someone to decode.

quests.title: Sew a patch or badge
quests.description: Design and sew (or glue) a patch or badge that marks one of your recent adventures.

quests.title: Write a thank-you letter
quests.description: Handwrite a thank-you letter to someone who shaped your life, and send it.

quests.title: Call someone you haven't spoken to in a year
quests.description: Phone (don't text) someone you have drifted away from and ask how they really are.

quests.title: Cook for someone
quests.description: Cook a meal for a friend, neighbour or family member, with no special occasion required.

quests.title: Ask an elder for a story
quests.description: Ask an older person in your life to tell you a story from their youth that you have never heard.

quests.title: Send a voice message instead of a text
quests.description: Send a friend a voice note telling them something you appreciate about them.

quests.title: Leave a kind note for a stranger
quests.description: Write an encouraging note and leave it where a stranger will find it: a library book, a bench, a bus stop.

quests.title: Plan a surprise for a friend
quests.description: Organise a small surprise for a friend: a delivery, a visit, a treasure hunt, a care package.

quests.title: Share a meal without screens
quests.description: Share a meal with someone and agree that all phones stay in another room.

quests.title: Learn a neighbour's name
quests.description: Introduce yourself to a neighbour whose name you don't know, and remember it.

quests.title: Write a letter to a grandparent or elder
quests.description: Write a real paper letter to a grandparent or older relative, full of small news.

quests.title: Host a game night
quests.description: Invite a few people over for board games, card games or a quiz you wrote yourself.

quests.title: Give a genuine compliment to three people
quests.description: Give three people specific, genuine compliments today about something other than appearance.

quests.title: Walk and talk
quests.description: Invite a friend on a walk instead of meeting at a café. Talk about something you both care about.

quests.title: Make a photo album for someone
quests.description: Gather photos of shared memories with someone and put them together as an album or printed collage.

quests.title: Ask a deep question
quests.description: In a conversation today, ask someone a question you've never asked them, such as 'What are you most proud of?'

quests.title: Send a postcard to an old friend
quests.description: Buy a local postcard and send it to an old friend with a short memory you share.

quests.title: Teach someone something you know
quests.description: Teach a friend or family member a skill you have, however small: a card trick, a recipe, a knot.

quests.title: Video call someone far away
quests.description: Schedule a proper, unhurried video call with someone who lives far away.

quests.title: Share your favourite place
quests.description: Take someone to your favourite secret spot and tell them why it matters to you.

quests.title: Write down what you love about someone
quests.description: Write a list of ten things you love about someone close to you. Decide whether to give it to them.

quests.title: Leave a surprise for a housemate or neighbour
quests.description: Leave a small, anonymous gift for a housemate or neighbour: flowers, a treat, a drawing.

quests.title: Visit a place you've only seen on a map
quests.description: Look at a map of your area, pick a name that intrigues you (a park, a lane, a hamlet) and go and see it.

quests.title: Explore a new neighbourhood
quests.description: Spend an hour wandering a neighbourhood you rarely or never visit. Find its best-kept secret.

quests.title: Enter a shop you've never entered
quests.description: Go into a speciality shop you have never visited: a tobacconist, a fabric shop, a tackle shop, an antiques dealer.

quests.title: Find the oldest building near you
quests.description: Research and visit the oldest surviving building in your area. Look for dates carved in stone.

quests.title: Read every plaque on one street
quests.description: Walk a historic street and read every plaque, memorial and inscription you find.

quests.title: Visit a local market
quests.description: Go to a market you have never been to and try at least one thing you have never tasted.

quests.title: Explore a cemetery
quests.description: Walk respectfully through an old cemetery. Read names and dates and imagine the lives behind them.

quests.title: Discover a street art trail
quests.description: Look up street art or murals in your area and plan a walking route that visits as many as you can.

quests.title: Visit a place of worship of another faith
quests.description: Visit a church, mosque, temple, synagogue or gurdwara you have never entered, respecting its customs.

quests.title: Find the source of a local name
quests.description: Find out why your street, town or district is called what it is. Visit the place that inspired the name if you can.

quests.title: Take a self-guided architecture tour
quests.description: Pick an architectural style (gothic, art deco, brutalist) and hunt for examples of it in your area.

quests.title: Explore the edge of the water
quests.description: Walk along a river, canal, lake or coastline for as far as you comfortably can.

quests.title: Find a secret garden
quests.description: Seek out a small hidden garden, courtyard or green space in your area that most people don't know about.

quests.title: Go up instead of along
quests.description: Visit a rooftop, bell tower, viewing platform or high floor and study your area from above.

quests.title: Visit a library you've never been to
quests.description: Go to a different library from your usual one and browse a section you've never looked at.

quests.title: Walk the whole of a bus route
quests.description: Pick a short bus route and walk it from one end to the other, seeing what the passengers miss.

quests.title: Find an abandoned railway or old road
quests.description: Research an old railway line, Roman road or disused path near you and walk a stretch of it.

quests.title: Explore at a different time of day
quests.description: Visit a familiar place at an unusual hour, early morning or late evening, and see how it changes.

quests.title: Discover a local legend
quests.description: Find a local legend, ghost story or folk tale connected to your area and visit the place it is about.

quests.title: Take a ferry or boat crossing
quests.description: Take any boat or ferry crossing, however short, and watch the shore from the water.

quests.title: Visit a castle or ruin
quests.description: Find the nearest castle, abbey, fort or ruin and walk its walls. Imagine who stood guard there.

quests.title: Explore the industrial side of town
quests.description: Walk through a working port, industrial estate or rail yard area (safely and legally) and observe how things get made and moved.

quests.title: Learn ten words in a new language
quests.description: Pick a language you know nothing of and learn ten useful words. Use one of them today.

quests.title: Learn to identify five trees
quests.description: Learn to recognise five trees by their leaves or bark, then go and find each one.

quests.title: Watch a documentary on something unfamiliar
quests.description: Choose a documentary about a subject you know nothing about and watch it with full attention.

quests.title: Learn a card trick
quests.description: Learn a simple card trick well enough to perform it for someone.

quests.title: Learn the history of your street
quests.description: Research what stood on your street a hundred years ago. Find an old photo if you can.

quests.title: Learn to juggle three objects
quests.description: Practise juggling with three soft objects. Keep going until you manage a few passes in a row.

quests.title: Learn five constellations
quests.description: Learn five constellations, then go outside on a clear night and find them.

quests.title: Take a free online lecture
quests.description: Watch a university lecture on a subject you never studied: philosophy, geology, medieval history.

quests.title: Learn a bird song
quests.description: Learn to recognise the song of one common local bird, then listen for it outdoors.

quests.title: Read a classic short story
quests.description: Read a short story by a writer you've heard of but never actually read.

quests.title: Learn a useful knot
quests.description: Learn to tie a bowline, clove hitch or sheet bend, and practise until you can do it without looking.

quests.title: Learn how something works
quests.description: Pick an everyday object (a lock, a zip, a flushing toilet) and learn exactly how it works.

quests.title: Memorise a poem
quests.description: Choose a poem you like and learn it by heart. Recite it aloud to someone or to the sky.

quests.title: Attend a public talk or workshop
quests.description: Find a free or cheap talk, workshop or class in your area and attend it.

quests.title: Learn to identify a wild edible
quests.description: Learn to safely identify one wild edible plant (like wild garlic or blackberry) and find it in the wild.

quests.title: Learn some sign language
quests.description: Learn to sign the alphabet and a few greetings in your local sign language.

quests.title: Learn a chord on an instrument
quests.description: Learn to play three chords on a guitar, ukulele or keyboard, or three notes on a whistle.

quests.title: Learn about a medieval craft
quests.description: Research how a medieval craft worked, such as blacksmithing, illumination or weaving, and try a small part of it.

quests.title: Learn to read a topographic map
quests.description: Learn how contour lines work and plan a walk using a topographic map.

quests.title: Learn the story behind a word
quests.description: Look up the etymology of five words you use every day. Find one with a surprising origin.

quests.title: Take apart an old gadget
quests.description: Safely dismantle a broken gadget and try to identify each component inside.

quests.title: Learn to navigate by the sun or stars
quests.description: Learn how to find north using the sun, a watch or the stars. Test it outside.

quests.title: Watch clouds for twenty minutes
quests.description: Lie down somewhere and watch the clouds. Name the shapes and the cloud types if you can.

quests.title: Find five kinds of lichen or moss
quests.description: Search walls, trees and stones for five different kinds of moss or lichen. Photograph each one.

quests.title: Sit in one spot in nature for thirty minutes
quests.description: Find a sit spot outdoors and stay completely still for thirty minutes. Notice who arrives when you are quiet.

quests.title: Go barefoot on grass
quests.description: Take off your shoes and walk barefoot on grass, sand or moss for a few minutes.

quests.title: Plant something
quests.description: Plant a seed, bulb, herb or tree, indoors or outside, and commit to looking after it.

quests.title: Birdwatching session
quests.description: Spend an hour watching birds. Try to identify at least five species.

quests.title: Find a spider's web with dew
quests.description: Go out early on a misty or dewy morning and find a spider web strung with water drops.

quests.title: Stargazing session
quests.description: Get away from bright lights on a clear night and look at the stars for half an hour. Try to spot a satellite.

quests.title: Collect autumn leaves
quests.description: Collect leaves in as many different colours and shapes as you can find, and press your favourites.

quests.title: Listen to a storm
quests.description: Sit safely by a window during a storm or heavy rain and simply listen for fifteen minutes.

quests.title: Track animal footprints
quests.description: Look for animal tracks in mud, sand or snow and try to work out who made them.

quests.title: Visit a botanical garden
quests.description: Visit a botanical garden or arboretum and find the strangest plant there.

quests.title: Rock pooling
quests.description: At low tide, explore rock pools and count the creatures you find. Put everything back gently.

quests.title: Forage for berries
quests.description: In season, gather blackberries, bilberries or other safe wild fruit and eat some fresh.

quests.title: Find the first sign of the season
quests.description: Look for the first sign of the coming season: a bud, a migrating bird, a fallen leaf, a frost.

quests.title: Watch a sunset without your phone
quests.description: Watch the entire sunset from start to finish, without taking a single photo.

quests.title: Hug a tree
quests.description: Find a tree you like and put your arms around it. Feel the texture of its bark and listen to its leaves.

quests.title: Gather a wildflower posy
quests.description: Pick a small bouquet of common wildflowers where it's allowed, or grow some, and learn their names.

quests.title: Night sounds survey
quests.description: Stand outside after dark and list every sound you can hear: owls, wind, traffic, insects.

quests.title: Walk in a forest
quests.description: Go to a forest or woodland and walk slowly, noticing the smell, the light and the silence.

quests.title: Catch snowflakes
quests.description: When it snows, catch snowflakes on a dark sleeve and look closely at their shapes.

quests.title: Butterfly and bee count
quests.description: Spend twenty minutes counting pollinators on a patch of flowers. Note which flowers are most popular.

quests.title: Go wild swimming
quests.description: Swim in a lake, river or sea at a safe, recognised spot, with a companion.

quests.title: Adopt a tree
quests.description: Choose a tree near you and visit it regularly. Today, photograph and sketch it for your records.

quests.title: Take a long bath by candlelight
quests.description: Run a bath, light a candle (or dim the lights) and soak without your phone for thirty minutes.

quests.title: A slow morning ritual
quests.description: Wake up a little earlier and spend the first thirty minutes doing something slow and lovely before any screens.

quests.title: Take yourself on a date
quests.description: Go alone to a café, film, museum or restaurant and enjoy your own company.

quests.title: Afternoon nap in a new spot
quests.description: Take a guilt-free twenty-minute nap somewhere unusual: a hammock, a park, a sunny patch of floor.

quests.title: Read in a sunny spot
quests.description: Find a patch of sunlight, indoors or out, and read a book for pleasure for half an hour.

quests.title: Digital sunset
quests.description: Switch off all screens two hours before bed and spend the evening by lamplight.

quests.title: Brew a proper pot of tea
quests.description: Make tea the slow way, with loose leaves or herbs and a pot, and drink it without doing anything else.

quests.title: Make a comfort box
quests.description: Fill a small box with things that cheer you up: letters, photos, a favourite snack, a smell you love.

quests.title: Go to bed at sundown
quests.description: Follow the rhythm of a medieval village: dim the lights at sunset and go to bed early.

quests.title: Visit a sauna, spa or bathhouse
quests.description: Treat yourself to a sauna, steam room, hot spring or public baths.

quests.title: Do absolutely nothing for fifteen minutes
quests.description: Sit and do nothing at all for fifteen minutes. No phone, no book, no plans.

quests.title: Give yourself a hand or foot massage
quests.description: Warm some oil or lotion and give your hands or feet a slow, careful massage.

quests.title: Wear your favourite outfit for no reason
quests.description: Put on the clothes that make you feel most like yourself, even if you're not going anywhere.

quests.title: Create a cosy reading nook
quests.description: Arrange blankets, cushions and a lamp to create a nook you want to curl up in, then use it.

quests.title: Breathe in the fresh air
quests.description: Step outside, close your eyes and take twenty slow, deep breaths.

quests.title: Cancel one unnecessary obligation
quests.description: Look at your week and kindly cancel or postpone one thing you are only doing out of guilt.

quests.title: Make a herbal remedy
quests.description: Make a soothing herbal infusion, bath salts or balm from simple ingredients, like an apothecary.

quests.title: Listen to an album start to finish
quests.description: Lie down and listen to a whole album, in order, without doing anything else.

quests.title: Sunbathe (sensibly) for ten minutes
quests.description: On a sunny day, sit in the sun for ten minutes and feel the warmth on your face.

quests.title: Plan a day of rest
quests.description: Plan a full day this month that is dedicated to rest and pleasure, and put it in your calendar.

quests.title: Get a haircut somewhere new
quests.description: Try a new barber or hairdresser, or a style you've been curious about.

quests.title: Cook a medieval recipe
quests.description: Find a genuine medieval recipe (pottage, frumenty, spiced wafers) and cook it tonight.

quests.title: Try a cuisine you've never eaten
quests.description: Eat a dish from a country whose food you have never tried, at a restaurant or cooked at home.

quests.title: Bake bread from scratch
quests.description: Bake a loaf of bread by hand, from flour, water, salt and yeast.

quests.title: Have a picnic
quests.description: Pack a picnic and eat it outdoors somewhere with a view, even if it's just a local park.

quests.title: Buy a fruit you've never tasted
quests.description: Find a fruit or vegetable you've never tasted, buy it and work out how to eat it.

quests.title: Cook over an open fire
quests.description: Cook something over a campfire, barbecue or fire pit, even just toasted bread or a sausage.

quests.title: Blind taste test
quests.description: Set up a blind taste test of three versions of one food (chocolate, apples, bread) and rank them.

quests.title: Make jam or preserves
quests.description: Make a small batch of jam, chutney or pickles, ideally from fruit you gathered yourself.

quests.title: Eat breakfast outside
quests.description: Take your breakfast outdoors: a balcony, doorstep, garden or park bench.

quests.title: Cook a dish from your family's past
quests.description: Cook a dish your parents or grandparents used to make. Ask someone for the recipe if you can.

quests.title: Visit a farm shop or farmers' market
quests.description: Buy your ingredients directly from the people who grew them.

quests.title: Host a feast
quests.description: Cook a feast of several dishes and invite people to share it at one long table.

quests.title: Make fresh pasta
quests.description: Make pasta from flour and eggs with your own hands, and cut it into shapes.

quests.title: Make your own spice blend
quests.description: Toast and grind whole spices into your own spice blend, then cook with it.

quests.title: Try a new tea or coffee
quests.description: Try a tea, coffee or hot drink you have never had before: mint tea, chai, yerba mate, spiced cider.

quests.title: Eat a meal in silence
quests.description: Eat one meal in complete silence, tasting every bite slowly.

quests.title: Cook with a single mystery ingredient
quests.description: Pick an ingredient in the shop without planning and build a dish around it.

quests.title: Brew a hot spiced drink
quests.description: Make a pot of mulled cider, spiced milk or hot chocolate with real spices, like an innkeeper.

quests.title: Take a cooking class
quests.description: Join a cooking class in a cuisine or technique you've never tried.

quests.title: Eat somewhere with a view
quests.description: Take your lunch to the most scenic spot you can reach today.

quests.title: Make a traveller's trail mix
quests.description: Make your own trail mix or energy bars to carry on your next expedition.

quests.title: Climb a tree
quests.description: Find a sturdy, safe tree and climb it, even just to the first branch.

quests.title: Try a new sport
quests.description: Try a sport you have never played: archery, fencing, climbing, frisbee, badminton.

quests.title: Dance alone in your kitchen
quests.description: Put on your favourite song and dance with complete abandon until it ends. Then play one more.

quests.title: Walk ten thousand steps somewhere new
quests.description: Walk ten thousand steps today, taking them through somewhere you've never walked.

quests.title: Swim somewhere different
quests.description: Swim at a pool, lido or beach you have never swum at before.

quests.title: Morning stretch outside
quests.description: Do fifteen minutes of stretching or yoga outside in the morning air.

quests.title: Cycle a new route
quests.description: Take a bike ride along a route you have never cycled before.

quests.title: Learn a martial arts form
quests.description: Learn a short sequence from tai chi, kung fu or historical swordsmanship, and practise it.

quests.title: Try archery
quests.description: Book an archery taster session and learn to loose an arrow like a medieval bowman.

quests.title: Take the stairs everywhere
quests.description: For one whole day, take the stairs everywhere instead of lifts and escalators.

quests.title: Run to a landmark
quests.description: Run (or jog, or brisk walk) to a landmark you can see from your home and back.

quests.title: Balance challenge
quests.description: Practise standing on one leg with your eyes closed. Then find a low wall or log to balance along.

quests.title: Go bouldering
quests.description: Visit a bouldering or climbing wall and try your first (or next) climbing routes.

quests.title: Carry the load
quests.description: Go on a walk carrying a loaded backpack, like a traveller with all their worldly goods.

quests.title: Play in a park like a child
quests.description: Visit a park and use the playground equipment or play a game of tag, catch or hopscotch.

quests.title: Attend a dance class
quests.description: Join a drop-in dance class: folk, swing, salsa, ceilidh or anything else that appeals.

quests.title: Hold a plank for your age in seconds
quests.description: Hold a plank for as many seconds as your age (build up in sets if needed).

quests.title: Fly a kite
quests.description: Make or buy a kite and fly it on a windy hill.

quests.title: Row, paddle or punt
quests.description: Get on the water in a rowing boat, canoe or punt and propel yourself along.

quests.title: Snowball fight or snow sculpture
quests.description: When there's snow, build a snow sculpture or start a friendly snowball battle.

quests.title: Sunrise run
quests.description: Go for a run or brisk walk that starts just as the sun is rising.

quests.title: Try a skipping rope
quests.description: Skip with a rope for five minutes, counting your longest streak. Try a trick.

quests.title: Write a gratitude list of ten small things
quests.description: Write down ten small, specific things you are grateful for today. The smaller the better.

quests.title: Map your life's journey
quests.description: Draw your life so far as a road map, with forks, detours, towns and landmarks.

quests.title: Walking meditation
quests.description: Walk very slowly for fifteen minutes, paying attention only to the feeling of each step.

quests.title: Write down a fear and a hope
quests.description: Write down one thing you fear and one thing you hope for. Read them aloud to yourself.

quests.title: Revisit a place from your childhood
quests.description: Go back to a place from your childhood, a school, a park, a street, and notice how it has changed.

quests.title: Keep a one-day observation journal
quests.description: Carry a notebook all day and write down every interesting thing you notice.

quests.title: Write your own quest list
quests.description: Write a list of twenty adventures you want to have in your life. Circle the one you can start this month.

quests.title: Sit by water and think
quests.description: Sit beside moving water for twenty minutes and let your thoughts drift with it.

quests.title: Look through old photographs
quests.description: Spend some time looking through old photos. Pick one and write the story behind it.

quests.title: Write a letter you won't send
quests.description: Write an honest letter to someone, living or not, that you will never send.

quests.title: Candlelit evening of thought
quests.description: Spend an evening with only candlelight (safely) and no screens, reading or thinking.

quests.title: List what you've learned this year
quests.description: Write down every new thing you have learned in the past twelve months, big or small.

quests.title: Pick a word for this season
quests.description: Choose a single word to guide you for the next three months. Write it somewhere you'll see it.

quests.title: Watch the moon rise
quests.description: Look up tonight's moonrise time, find a spot with a view east and watch it appear.

quests.title: Write your personal legend
quests.description: Write a short legend about yourself in the third person, as a minstrel would sing it.

quests.title: Spend an hour in a quiet place
quests.description: Find a truly quiet place, such as a library, chapel, woodland or empty hall, and spend an hour there.

quests.title: Ask yourself three big questions
quests.description: Journal your answers to: What gives me energy? What drains me? What am I avoiding?

quests.title: Plan a pilgrimage
quests.description: Plan a meaningful long walk to a place that matters to you. Choose the date.

quests.title: Record a sound diary
quests.description: Record ten short sounds throughout your day that capture what your life sounds like right now.

quests.title: Write a mission statement
quests.description: Write the creed of your own order of knights: what do you stand for, and what will you defend?

quests.title: Join a local club for one meeting
quests.description: Attend a single meeting of a local club: chess, walking, choir, book club, historical re-enactment.

quests.title: Volunteer for a morning
quests.description: Volunteer for a few hours at a food bank, animal shelter, garden or community event.

quests.title: Go to a quiz night
quests.description: Go to a pub quiz or trivia night, with friends or by joining a team of strangers.

quests.title: Talk to a stranger
quests.description: Have a real conversation with a stranger: in a queue, on a bench, at a bus stop.

quests.title: Attend a local festival or fair
quests.description: Find a local festival, fête, fair or street party and go.

quests.title: Organise a picnic with friends
quests.description: Gather some friends for a picnic in a park. Everyone brings one dish.

quests.title: Join a group walk or run
quests.description: Join an organised group walk, parkrun or hiking group.

quests.title: Attend an open mic night
quests.description: Go to an open mic night. Perform if you dare, or cheer loudly for those who do.

quests.title: Invite someone new for coffee
quests.description: Invite a colleague, neighbour or acquaintance you'd like to know better for a coffee.

quests.title: Play a board game with others
quests.description: Play a board or card game with family, friends or at a board-game café.

quests.title: Go to a community workshop
quests.description: Attend a repair café, community garden session or maker space open day.

quests.title: Start a friendly competition
quests.description: Challenge a friend to a playful contest: best photo, best paper plane, longest skip streak.

quests.title: Take part in a litter pick
quests.description: Join or organise a litter pick in a park, beach or street.

quests.title: Sing with others
quests.description: Sing with other people: a choir, karaoke, a campfire singalong or a family car journey.

quests.title: Attend a meetup about a hobby
quests.description: Find a meetup for a hobby you're curious about and go along as a beginner.

quests.title: Help a neighbour
quests.description: Offer a neighbour help with something: carrying shopping, fixing something, walking their dog.

quests.title: Host a potluck
quests.description: Host a potluck dinner where everyone brings a dish with a story behind it.

quests.title: Try a group dance
quests.description: Join a ceilidh, barn dance or folk dance evening, where everyone dances with everyone.

quests.title: Share a skill at a gathering
quests.description: Offer to teach a short skill at a community gathering, club or among friends.

quests.title: Make someone laugh out loud
quests.description: Tell a joke, share a ridiculous story or do something silly that makes someone laugh.

quests.title: Visit a museum you've never been to
quests.description: Visit a museum you've never entered and find the single most unexpected object in it.

quests.title: Watch a foreign film
quests.description: Watch a film in a language you don't speak, from a country whose cinema you don't know.

quests.title: See live music
quests.description: Go to a live performance of music you wouldn't normally listen to.

quests.title: Read a book from another century
quests.description: Start reading a book written more than a hundred years ago.

quests.title: Attend a theatre performance
quests.description: See a play, puppet show, opera or amateur dramatic production.

quests.title: Learn a folk song
quests.description: Learn the words to a traditional folk song from your region or another, and sing it through.

quests.title: Read about a medieval legend
quests.description: Read the original version of a medieval legend: Arthur, Beowulf, Robin Hood, Tristan and Isolde.

quests.title: Visit a historic house
quests.description: Visit a historic house or heritage site and imagine a day in the life of someone who lived there.

quests.title: Listen to a whole symphony
quests.description: Listen to a complete classical symphony, start to finish, without distraction.

quests.title: Go to a poetry reading
quests.description: Attend a poetry reading or spoken-word night.

quests.title: Explore a culture's festival food
quests.description: Learn about a festival from another culture and cook or eat one of its traditional foods.

quests.title: Visit a bookshop and buy by the cover
quests.description: Visit a second-hand bookshop and buy a book purely because of its cover or title.

quests.title: Watch a silent film
quests.description: Watch a silent film from the 1920s and pay attention to how it tells its story without words.

quests.title: Learn about a local craftsperson
quests.description: Visit a local craftsperson's workshop or studio: a potter, a blacksmith, a luthier.

quests.title: See a medieval re-enactment or fair
quests.description: Find a medieval fair, jousting show or re-enactment event and attend it.

quests.title: Listen to music from a new country
quests.description: Spend an evening exploring the music of a country you know nothing about.

quests.title: Read a myth from another culture
quests.description: Read a myth or folk tale from a culture far from your own.

quests.title: Visit a free lunchtime concert
quests.description: Find a free lunchtime or church concert and spend your lunch listening.

quests.title: Try an illuminated letter
quests.description: Look at illuminated manuscripts online, then decorate the first letter of your name in the same style.

quests.title: Learn about the history of a local festival
quests.description: Research the origins of a festival or tradition celebrated where you live.

quests.title: Watch a play by Shakespeare
quests.description: Watch a Shakespeare play, live or recorded, that you have never seen.

quests.title: Say yes to the next invitation
quests.description: Say yes to the next reasonable invitation you receive today, however unusual.

quests.title: Let a coin decide
quests.description: At every junction on a walk, flip a coin: heads left, tails right. Walk for thirty minutes.

quests.title: Order the strangest thing on the menu
quests.description: Next time you eat out, order the dish you understand least.

quests.title: Change your routine completely for a morning
quests.description: Do your morning routine in reverse order, or in a different room, or at a different time.

quests.title: Point at a map and go
quests.description: Close your eyes, point at a local map and go to the nearest reachable spot to where your finger lands.

quests.title: Take a spontaneous day trip
quests.description: Pick a destination within two hours and go today, with no plan beyond getting there.

quests.title: Follow a stranger's recommendation
quests.description: Ask a shopkeeper, librarian or barista for their favourite local thing, then go and do it.

quests.title: Pick a book from a random shelf
quests.description: In a library or bookshop, walk to a random shelf, take the fifth book and read its first chapter.

quests.title: Get off one stop early
quests.description: Get off the bus or train one stop early and walk the rest of the way on a route you don't know.

quests.title: Dice-driven afternoon
quests.description: Write six small activities on a list and roll a die to decide what you do next, three times in a row.

quests.title: Eat dessert first
quests.description: At one meal today, eat dessert before the main course. Enjoy the rebellion.

quests.title: Try something you've always said no to
quests.description: Pick one thing you usually refuse (a food, an activity, a genre) and give it a fair try.

quests.title: Follow the music
quests.description: When you hear music outside, from a busker, a café or an open window, walk towards it.

quests.title: Surprise yourself at the cinema
quests.description: Go to the cinema and see whatever film starts next, without checking what it is.

quests.title: Wear something bold
quests.description: Wear an item of clothing that is more colourful or unusual than you normally dare.

quests.title: Random act of generosity
quests.description: Do a spontaneous generous act: pay for a stranger's coffee, leave a book, give flowers away.

quests.title: Sleep somewhere different
quests.description: Spend a night somewhere new: a hostel, a friend's sofa, a tent in the garden, a different room.

quests.title: Be a tourist in your own town
quests.description: Spend a few hours as a tourist in your own town: pick up a leaflet, take the tour, buy a postcard.

quests.title: Sunrise to sunset challenge
quests.description: Spend an entire day, from sunrise to sunset, mostly outdoors.

quests.title: Go where the wind blows
quests.description: Walk in the direction the wind is blowing for fifteen minutes, then find your way home differently.

quests.title: Choose a random hobby for a day
quests.description: Look up a list of hobbies, pick one at random and spend an hour trying it.

quests.title: Write a message in a bottle
quests.description: Write a message to a stranger and leave it where someone will find it (responsibly, not in the sea).
